content: The bug is in `django/contrib/admin/sites.py:423` — the redirect target is built from `request.path_info` (script name stripped), so with `FORCE_SCRIPT_NAME` set the redirect drops the script prefix. The fix (matching upstream PR #14404): resolve against `path_info` (what the URL resolver expects) but redirect to `request.path` (includes the script name).
